weeks.title: Aerospace, the Atmosphere and Units
weeks.summary: Is week aap seekhoge ki aeronautics aur space technology kya cover karte hain, atmosphere ki layers aur ISA model se altitude par temperature, pressure aur density kaise nikalte hain, aur units, dimensions aur significant digits ka sahi use.
concepts: **Aeronautics vs astronautics**: aeronautics un vehicles ki study hai jo atmosphere ke andar hawa ki madad se udte hain (aeroplane, helicopter, balloon). Astronautics/space technology un systems ki hai jo atmosphere ke bahar kaam karte hain (rockets, satellites, space probes). Dono milkar **aerospace** kehlaate hain.

**Atmosphere ki layers** (neeche se upar): **troposphere** (lagbhag 11 km tak, saara weather yahin, height ke saath temperature girta hai), **stratosphere** (lagbhag 50 km tak, ozone layer, temperature pehle constant phir badhta hai), **mesosphere** (lagbhag 85 km tak, temperature girta hai), **thermosphere** (bahut patli hawa, temperature badhta hai). Airliners troposphere ke top ya lower stratosphere mein cruise karte hain.

**Space kahan se shuru**: koi sharp boundary nahi hai, par 100 km ki **Kármán line** ko conventionally space ki shuruaat maana jaata hai. Itni height par hawa itni patli hai ki wing se lift lene ke liye orbital speed ke kareeb udna padega.

**ISA (International Standard Atmosphere)**: ek reference model jisse sab aircraft performance compare karte hain. Sea level par T₀ = 288.15 K (15 °C), p₀ = 101325 Pa, ρ₀ = 1.225 kg/m³. Troposphere mein temperature **6.5 K per km** girta hai: T = 288.15 − 6.5h (h km mein), 11 km par 216.65 K. 11 se 20 km tak T constant rehta hai.

**Ideal gas law**: p = ρRT, jahan hawa ke liye R = 287 J/(kg·K) aur T hamesha **kelvin** mein. Troposphere mein pressure ratio p/p₀ = (T/T₀)^5.256 se nikalta hai. Pressure aur density height ke saath tezi se girte hain: lagbhag 5.5 km par pressure sea level ka aadha reh jaata hai.

**SI units aur conversions**: length m, mass kg, time s, force N (= kg·m/s²), pressure Pa (= N/m²). Aviation mein feet aur knots bhi chalte hain: 1 ft = 0.3048 m, 1 knot = 0.5144 m/s, 1 nautical mile = 1852 m. Calculation hamesha SI mein convert karke karo.

**Dimensions**: har physical quantity ko M, L, T ke combination se likh sakte hain, jaise force = MLT⁻², pressure = ML⁻¹T⁻². Equation ke dono sides ki dimensions same honi chahiye. Lift coefficient C_L jaise coefficients **dimensionless** hote hain.

**Significant digits**: multiplication/division ka answer utne hi significant digits mein do jitne sabse kam precise input mein hain. 2.5 (2 s.f.) × 1.225 (4 s.f.) ka answer 2 s.f. mein. Calculator ke saare digits likhna false precision hai.

example.problem: ISA model use karke 3 km altitude par temperature, pressure aur density nikalo. (T₀ = 288.15 K, p₀ = 101325 Pa, lapse rate 6.5 K/km, p/p₀ = (T/T₀)^5.256, R = 287 J/(kg·K))
steps: Check: ρ/ρ₀ = 0.909/1.225 ≈ 0.74, yaani 3 km par hawa sea level se lagbhag 26% patli hai.

mistakes: Ideal gas law mein temperature °C mein daal dena. p = ρRT mein T hamesha kelvin (°C + 273.15) mein hona chahiye, warna density bilkul galat ya negative aa sakti hai.
Feet, knots aur km/h ko SI mein convert kiye bina formula mein daal dena. Pehle sab kuch m, kg, s mein badlo, phir calculate karo.
Pressure ko height ke saath linearly girta maan lena. Troposphere mein temperature linear girta hai, par pressure power law (exponent 5.256) se girta hai.
revision: Layers: troposphere → stratosphere → mesosphere → thermosphere; weather troposphere mein.
ISA sea level: 288.15 K, 101325 Pa, 1.225 kg/m³.
Troposphere mein T = 288.15 − 6.5h (h km mein), 11 km tak.
p = ρRT, R = 287 J/(kg·K), T kelvin mein.
Answer utne significant digits mein jitne sabse kam precise input mein.

questions.question: Atmosphere ki kis layer mein lagbhag saara weather (clouds, rain) hota hai aur height badhne par temperature girta hai?
questions.explanation: Troposphere sabse neeche wali layer hai (lagbhag 11 km tak). Saari water vapour aur weather yahin hai aur temperature height ke saath girta hai. Trap: mesosphere mein bhi temperature girta hai, par wahan weather nahi hota; stratosphere mein ozone hai aur temperature badhta hai.

questions.question: ISA model mein 4 km altitude par temperature kya hoga? (sea level 288.15 K, lapse rate 6.5 K/km)
questions.explanation: T = 288.15 − 6.5 × 4 = 288.15 − 26 = 262.15 K. Troposphere mein upar jaate hue temperature ghatta hai. Trap: 314.15 K tab aata hai jab 26 K ghatane ki jagah jod do; 248.15 K tab jab lapse rate 10 K/km le lo.

questions.question: Kisi altitude par pressure 61,640 Pa aur temperature 262.15 K hai. Hawa ke liye R = 287 J/(kg·K) lekar density kya hogi?
questions.explanation: ρ = p/(RT) = 61,640 / (287 × 262.15) ≈ 0.819 kg/m³. Trap: pressure ko kPa (61.64) mein daalne se 8.19 × 10⁻⁴ aata hai, aur universal constant 8.314 use karne se 28.3 aata hai; 1.225 sirf sea-level ki value hai.

questions.question: Ek airliner 33,000 ft par cruise kar raha hai. 1 ft = 0.3048 m lekar ye altitude km mein kitni hai?
questions.explanation: 33,000 × 0.3048 = 10,058 m ≈ 10.06 km. Trap: 0.3048 se multiply karne ki jagah divide karne par 108.3 km aata hai, jo atmosphere ke bhi bahar hai; is tarah ka sanity check hamesha karo.

questions.question: Ek gas cell ka volume 2.5 m³ (measured) hai aur hawa ki density 1.225 kg/m³ hai. Andar ki hawa ka mass sahi significant digits ke saath kya likhoge?
questions.explanation: 1.225 × 2.5 = 3.0625, par 2.5 mein sirf 2 significant digits hain, isliye answer 2 s.f. mein: 3.1 kg. Trap: calculator ke saare digits (3.0625) likhna false precision hai, aur 3 kg mein sirf 1 s.f. reh jaata hai.

questions.question: ISA troposphere mein p/p₀ = (T/T₀)^5.256. 11 km par T = 216.65 K, T₀ = 288.15 K aur p₀ = 101.325 kPa. 11 km par pressure lagbhag kitna hai?
questions.explanation: T/T₀ = 216.65/288.15 = 0.752. (0.752)^5.256 ≈ 0.223, to p ≈ 0.223 × 101.325 ≈ 22.6 kPa. Trap: exponent bhool kar sirf temperature ratio lagane par 76.2 kPa aata hai, aur exponent ko 1/5.256 le lene par 96.0 kPa. Pressure temperature se bahut tezi se girta hai.

weeks.title: Where Aerospace Systems Are Used
weeks.summary: Is week aap civil aur military aviation, satellites, UAVs aur unconventional aerospace systems ke applications seekhoge, aur simple numbers (signal delay, drone endurance, fuel per passenger) se unki limits samjhoge.
concepts: **Civil aviation**: scheduled passenger airlines, cargo, business jets, general aviation (training, private flying), air ambulance aur helicopters se search-and-rescue. Yahan sabse bade goals hain safety, cost per seat-km aur fuel efficiency.

**Military aviation**: fighters (air superiority, ground attack), transport aircraft, aerial refuelling tankers, maritime patrol, surveillance aur early-warning aircraft, aur training. Yahan performance (speed, manoeuvrability, payload) aur survivability cost se zyada important ho sakte hain. HAL Tejas India ka light combat aircraft hai.

**Satellites ke applications**: communication (TV, internet, phone), navigation (GPS, aur India ka regional system NavIC), remote sensing (crops, floods, maps), weather monitoring, aur science. Application se orbit decide hota hai: communication ke liye aksar GEO, imaging ke liye aksar LEO.

**GEO aur signal delay**: geostationary satellite equator ke upar lagbhag 35,786 km par hota hai aur ground se ek jagah ruka hua dikhta hai, isliye fixed dish antenna kaam karta hai. Teen GEO satellites poles ko chhod kar lagbhag poori Earth cover kar lete hain. Par itni doori se signal ko ground → satellite → ground jaane mein lagbhag 0.24 s lagta hai.

**Sun-synchronous orbit**: ek polar-type LEO jismein satellite har baar kisi jagah ke upar same local solar time par aata hai. Isse har image mein lighting lagbhag same rehti hai, jo crop ya flood images compare karne ke liye zaroori hai.

**UAVs (drones)**: bina pilot ke on-board udne wale aircraft, remote se ya autonomously control. Uses: agriculture spraying, mapping/survey, delivery, disaster assessment, military surveillance. Battery-powered drones ki sabse badi limit **endurance** hai: flight time ≈ usable battery energy / power.

**Unconventional systems**: high-altitude balloons aur airships, solar-powered long-endurance aircraft (high-altitude pseudo-satellites), eVTOL air taxis, reusable launch vehicles, hypersonic vehicles. Ye wahan use hote hain jahan conventional aircraft ya satellite mehenga ya mushkil ho.

**System view**: har application ek mission requirement se shuru hota hai (kitna payload, kitni door, kitni der, kitni height). Wahi requirement vehicle ka type, size, propulsion aur cost decide karti hai.

example.problem: Ek agriculture drone ki battery 22.2 V aur 6 Ah ki hai. Sirf 80% energy use karni hai (battery bachane ke liye). Spraying ke time drone 400 W power leta hai. Flight time kitna milega?
steps: Flight time = energy / power = 106.56 Wh / 400 W = 0.2664 h.
Matlab ek bada khet cover karne ke liye kai battery swaps chahiye; isliye mission plan mein battery count bhi shamil hota hai.

mistakes: GEO ko 'sab satellites ka orbit' samajhna. Imaging aur navigation ke liye LEO/MEO bhi use hote hain; GEO tab chahiye jab satellite ko ground se ek jagah ruka hua dikhna ho.
Battery ka Ah (charge) ko seedha energy maan lena. Energy (Wh) = voltage × Ah; phir power (W) se divide karke hours milte hain, minutes ke liye 60 se multiply karo.
Signal delay mein sirf ek leg (ground se satellite) lena jab signal ko ground se ground tak jaana hai. Up aur down dono legs jodo.
revision: Civil: passenger, cargo, training, rescue; military: fighter, transport, tanker, surveillance.
Communication: aksar GEO (35,786 km); imaging: aksar sun-synchronous LEO.
GEO hop (ground → satellite → ground) ≈ 0.24 s.
Drone endurance ≈ usable Wh / power in W (hours mein).
Mission requirement → vehicle type, size aur propulsion.

questions.question: TV broadcast ke liye aisa satellite chahiye jo ground se hamesha ek hi jagah dikhe, taaki ghar ki dish ko ghumana na pade. Kaunsa orbit sahi hai?
questions.explanation: GEO satellite equator ke upar Earth ke rotation jitne period se ghoomta hai, isliye ground se ruka hua dikhta hai aur fixed dish kaam karti hai. Trap: sun-synchronous orbit bhi 'synchronous' sunta hai, par woh Sun ke saath sync hai, Earth ki surface ke saath nahi; uska satellite aasmaan mein chalta rehta hai.

questions.question: In mein se kaunsa role military aviation ka hai, civil aviation ka nahi?
options: Fighters ko hawa mein refuel karna (aerial refuelling tanker)
Drone se khet mein pesticide spraying
questions.explanation: Fighters ka aerial refuelling ek military mission hai jo combat aircraft ki range badhata hai. Passenger flights, air ambulance aur crop spraying sab civil applications hain. Trap: drone ko automatically military samajh lena; drones civil kaam mein bhi bahut use hote hain.

questions.question: Ek GEO satellite ground station ke theek upar 35,786 km par hai. Signal ko ground se satellite aur wapas ground tak (ek hop) jaane mein kitna time lagega? (c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s)
questions.explanation: Kul doori = 2 × 35,786 km = 71,572 km = 7.157 × 10⁷ m. Time = 7.157 × 10⁷/(3 × 10⁸) ≈ 0.24 s. Trap: 0.12 s sirf ek leg (upar jaana) hai, aur 0.48 s do hops (sawaal aur jawaab) ka time hai, jo phone call mein feel hota hai.

questions.question: Ek survey drone ki battery 111 Wh ki hai, jismein se sirf 80% use karni hai. Drone 300 W power leta hai. Flight time kitna milega?
questions.explanation: Usable energy = 0.8 × 111 = 88.8 Wh. Time = 88.8 / 300 = 0.296 h = 0.296 × 60 ≈ 17.8 min. Trap: 80% bhool jaane par 22.2 min aata hai, aur hours ko minutes mein convert na karne par 0.30 likh dete hain; 3.38 h tab aata hai jab power ko energy se divide kar do.

questions.question: Remote-sensing (imaging) satellites ke liye aksar sun-synchronous orbit kyun choose kiya jaata hai?
options: Satellite har baar kisi jagah ke upar same local solar time par aata hai, isliye images mein lighting lagbhag same rehti hai
Satellite ground se ek jagah ruka hua dikhta hai
Ye orbit Earth se sabse door hai, isliye poori Earth ek saath dikhti hai
Is orbit mein satellite ko kabhi Sun ki roshni nahi milti
questions.explanation: Sun-synchronous orbit ka plane Sun ke saath sync mein ghoomta hai, isliye satellite har pass par same local time par aata hai aur shadows/lighting comparable rehte hain, jo changes detect karne ke liye zaroori hai. Trap: 'ruka hua dikhna' GEO ki property hai, sun-synchronous ki nahi.

questions.question: Ek airliner cruise mein 2,400 kg fuel per hour jalata hai aur 800 km/h se udta hai. 180 passengers hain. 1,200 km ki cruise mein per passenger kitna fuel lagega? (sirf cruise, baaki phases ignore karo)
questions.explanation: Time = 1,200/800 = 1.5 h. Total fuel = 2,400 × 1.5 = 3,600 kg. Per passenger = 3,600/180 = 20 kg. Trap: 3,600 kg poore aircraft ka fuel hai, 13.3 kg sirf ek ghante ka per-passenger fuel hai (1.5 h bhool gaye), aur 0.0167 kg per passenger per km hai.

weeks.title: Classifying Aircraft: Aerostats and Aerodynes
weeks.summary: Is week aap aircraft ki do badi families seekhoge: aerostats (balloons, airships) jo buoyancy se udte hain aur aerodynes (aeroplanes, helicopters, multirotors) jo aerodynamic lift se udte hain, aur buoyancy aur hover thrust ke simple calculations.
concepts: **Do families**: **aerostat** (lighter-than-air) hawa se halki gas ki buoyancy se udta hai, jaise balloon aur airship. **Aerodyne** (heavier-than-air) apne weight se zyada force hawa ko neeche dhakel kar paata hai, jaise aeroplane, glider, helicopter, multirotor.

**Buoyancy (Archimedes principle)**: hawa mein dooba object utni upward force paata hai jitna usne hawa ka weight hataya. Net lift = (ρ_air − ρ_gas) × V × g. Mass ke terms mein, har m³ gas (ρ_air − ρ_gas) kg utha sakti hai. Sea level par helium (ρ ≈ 0.169 kg/m³) lagbhag 1.06 kg per m³ uthata hai.

**Lifting gas**: hydrogen sabse halka hai par flammable hai; helium thoda kam lift deta hai par inert aur safe hai; **hot air** (lagbhag 100 °C) sirf thoda halka hota hai, isliye hot-air balloon ko bahut bada volume chahiye. Hot air ki density ρ = ρ_air × T_ambient/T_hot (dono kelvin mein, same pressure).

**Balloon vs airship**: balloon hawa ke saath bahta hai, sirf upar-neeche control hota hai. **Airship** mein engine/propellers aur control fins hote hain, isliye usse steer kar sakte hain. Altitude badhne par ρ_air ghatta hai, isliye same volume ki lift bhi ghatti hai.

**Fixed-wing aerodyne**: aeroplane ka wing aage badhte hue lift banata hai, aur engine thrust drag ko balance karta hai. Steady level flight mein lift = weight aur thrust = drag. Glider ke paas engine nahi; woh height ko speed mein badal kar glide karta hai.

**Rotary-wing**: helicopter ka main rotor ghoomta hua wing hai jo lift aur (tilt karne par) forward force deta hai. Rotor ka reaction torque body ko ulta ghumaata hai, isliye **tail rotor** us torque ko balance karta hai aur yaw control deta hai. HAL Dhruv India ka helicopter hai jo is tarah ka main + tail rotor layout use karta hai.

**Multirotor (quadcopter)**: chaar ya zyada fixed-pitch propellers, aadhe clockwise aur aadhe anticlockwise, taaki torque cancel ho jaaye. Motors ki speed badal kar control: hover mein kul thrust = weight, yaani har motor weight/4 deta hai. Achhe control ke liye design mein total max thrust lagbhag weight ka do guna rakha jaata hai.

**Kaise choose karein**: aerostats bahut der tak kam energy mein hawa mein reh sakte hain par slow aur wind-sensitive hain. Aeroplanes fast aur efficient cruise dete hain par runway chahiye. Helicopters aur multirotors hover kar sakte hain aur kahin bhi utar sakte hain par hover mein bahut power lagti hai.

example.problem: Ek hot-air balloon ka envelope 2,800 m³ hai. Bahar hawa 288.15 K par hai (ρ = 1.225 kg/m³) aur andar ki hawa 373.15 K par garam ki gayi hai (same pressure). Balloon kitna mass (envelope + basket + log) utha sakta hai?
steps: Same pressure par density temperature ke ulte proportional hai: ρ_hot = 1.225 × 288.15/373.15.
Comparison: helium (0.169 kg/m³) se yahi volume lagbhag 1.056 × 2,800 ≈ 2,957 kg uthata, isliye hot-air balloon itne bade hote hain.

mistakes: Buoyancy mein sirf hataayi hui hawa ka weight lena aur andar ki gas ka weight ghatana bhool jaana. Net lift = (ρ_air − ρ_gas) × V × g.
Hot air ki density nikalte waqt °C ka ratio lena (15/100). Ratio hamesha kelvin mein lo: 288.15/373.15.
Helicopter ke tail rotor ko extra lift ka source samajhna. Uska kaam main rotor ke torque ko balance karna aur yaw control dena hai.
revision: Aerostat = buoyancy (balloon, airship); aerodyne = aerodynamic lift (aeroplane, helicopter, multirotor).
Net lift = (ρ_air − ρ_gas) V g; helium ≈ 1.06 kg per m³ sea level par.
Hot air: ρ_hot = ρ_air × T_amb/T_hot (kelvin).
Level flight: L = W, T = D.
Tail rotor torque balance karta hai; quadcopter hover mein har motor W/4.

questions.question: In mein se kaunsa aerostat (lighter-than-air) hai?
questions.explanation: Hot-air balloon andar ki garam, halki hawa ki buoyancy se udta hai, isliye aerostat hai. Glider, helicopter aur quadcopter sab hawa se bhaari hain aur wing/rotor ki aerodynamic lift se udte hain. Trap: glider mein engine nahi hota, par woh bhi wing ki lift se hi udta hai.

questions.question: Ek conventional helicopter mein tail rotor ka main kaam kya hai?
options: Extra lift dena taaki zyada payload uth sake
Forward flight ke liye thrust dena
Main rotor ke reaction torque ko balance karna aur yaw control dena
Engine ko thanda rakhne ke liye hawa dena
questions.explanation: Engine jab main rotor ko ghumata hai, to reaction torque helicopter ki body ko ulti direction mein ghumane lagta hai. Tail rotor sideways thrust deta hai jo is torque ko balance karta hai, aur uski thrust badal kar pilot yaw control karta hai. Trap: forward thrust main rotor ko aage tilt karne se aata hai, tail rotor se nahi.

questions.question: Ek helium balloon ka volume 600 m³ hai. ρ_air = 1.225 kg/m³ aur ρ_He = 0.169 kg/m³. Balloon kul kitna mass (envelope + payload) utha sakta hai?
questions.explanation: Har m³ ki net lift = 1.225 − 0.169 = 1.056 kg. Kul = 1.056 × 600 ≈ 634 kg. Trap: 735 kg tab aata hai jab helium ka apna weight ghatana bhool jaao; 6,216 asal mein newton mein force hai (634 × 9.81), use kg likhna unit galti hai.

questions.question: Sea level par ρ_air = 1.225 kg/m³ (288.15 K) aur ρ_He = 0.169 kg/m³. Ek hot-air balloon andar ki hawa 373.15 K tak garam karta hai (same pressure). Same net lift ke liye hot-air balloon ko helium balloon se lagbhag kitne guna volume chahiye?
questions.explanation: ρ_hot = 1.225 × 288.15/373.15 ≈ 0.946, to hot air ki lift = 1.225 − 0.946 = 0.279 kg/m³. Helium ki lift = 1.056 kg/m³. Ratio = 1.056/0.279 ≈ 3.78. Trap: 1.30 sirf temperatures (ya densities) ka ratio hai, net lift ka nahi; 0.26 ratio ulta le lene se aata hai.

questions.question: Ek quadcopter ka mass 1.5 kg hai (g = 9.81 m/s²). Steady hover mein har motor ko kitna thrust dena padega?
questions.explanation: Weight = 1.5 × 9.81 = 14.7 N. Hover mein kul thrust = weight, aur chaar motors mein barabar baanto: 14.7/4 ≈ 3.68 N. Trap: 14.7 N poore drone ka thrust hai; 7.36 N tab chahiye jab thrust-to-weight 2 ho (manoeuvre ke liye max thrust), hover ke liye nahi.

questions.question: Ek 1,000 m³ helium balloon sea level par (ρ_air = 1.225, ρ_He = 0.169 kg/m³) 1,056 kg utha sakta hai. 3 km par ρ_air = 0.909 aur ρ_He = 0.126 kg/m³ hai. Volume same rahe to 3 km par kitna mass utha payega?
questions.explanation: 3 km par net lift = (0.909 − 0.126) × 1,000 = 783 kg. Hawa aur helium dono patle ho jaate hain, isliye lift lagbhag ρ_air ke ratio (0.909/1.225 ≈ 0.74) se ghatti hai. Trap: volume same hai to lift same (1,056 kg) maan lena; 1,099 kg sea-level hawa aur 3 km helium ko mix karne se aata hai.

weeks.title: The Disciplines Behind an Aircraft
weeks.summary: Is week aap aerospace ke main fields (aerodynamics, flight dynamics aur control, propulsion, structures, avionics, ground support, safety aur security) seekhoge, aur wing loading, thrust-to-weight aur weight budget jaise numbers se dekhoge ki design mein ye ek doosre ko kaise affect karte hain.
concepts: **Aerodynamics**: hawa vehicle par kaise forces lagati hai, yaani lift aur drag. Wing shape, area aur angle choose karna is field ka kaam hai. Goal: kam drag mein zaroori lift.
**Flight dynamics and control**: vehicle forces aur moments ke under kaise move karta hai, stable hai ya nahi, aur control surfaces, autopilot aur control laws se use kaise control karein.
**Propulsion**: thrust kaise banaye, yaani piston engine + propeller, gas turbine (jet) ya rocket. Engine ka weight, fuel consumption aur thrust poore design ko decide karte hain.
**Structures and materials**: airframe ko itna strong aur stiff banana ki saare loads seh le, par jitna ho sake halka. Har extra kg structure ka matlab hai kam payload ya zyada fuel.

**Avionics and communication**: on-board electronics, yaani navigation, sensors, displays, flight computers, radios aur data links. **Ground support**: maintenance, refuelling, air traffic control, airports, aur spacecraft ke liye launch site aur mission control. **Safety and security**: failures aur galtiyon se bachaav (safety) aur jaan-boojh kar nuksaan se bachaav (security).

**Wing loading W/S**: weight ko wing area se divide karo (N/m²). Kam W/S matlab kam stall speed aur chhota runway; zyada W/S matlab gusty hawa mein smooth ride aur kam drag wala chhota wing. **Thrust-to-weight T/W**: kul thrust / weight (dimensionless). Airliners ka T/W lagbhag 0.25–0.4, fighters ka 1 ke aas-paas ya usse zyada.

**Weight budget**: maximum take-off weight (MTOW) = operating empty weight + payload + fuel. MTOW fixed ho to empty weight mein har badhotari seedha payload ya fuel se katti hai. Isliye structures aur avionics ka weight poore aircraft ki capability affect karta hai.

**Interaction aur trade-offs**: bada wing take-off aur landing aasaan karta hai par structure bhaari aur cruise drag zyada. Bada engine T/W badhata hai par zyada fuel peeta hai aur weight badhata hai. Flutter jaisi problems aerodynamics aur structures dono ko saath samjhe bina solve nahi hoti. Design iterative hai: ek field ka change doosre ke numbers badal deta hai.

example.problem: Ek trainer aircraft ka MTOW 1,200 kg, wing area 15 m² aur engine ki static thrust 3.6 kN hai (g = 9.81 m/s²). Wing loading aur thrust-to-weight nikalo.
steps: Interpretation: T/W < 1 hai, isliye ye aircraft vertical climb nahi kar sakta; use wing ki lift chahiye aur runway par speed pakadni padti hai.
Agar designer wing area 15 se 18 m² kar de, to W/S 654 N/m² ho jaayega: stall speed kam, par wing bhaari aur drag zyada.

mistakes: Wing loading mein mass (kg) ko seedha N/m² likh dena. Newton chahiye to pehle g se multiply karo; kg/m² aur N/m² alag units hain.
T/W mein sirf ek engine ka thrust lena jab aircraft ke do ya chaar engines hain. Kul installed thrust lo.
Fields ko alag-alag box samajhna. Avionics ka extra weight bhi payload kam karta hai, aur engine ki position structure aur stability dono ko badalti hai.
revision: Main fields: aero, flight dynamics/control, propulsion, structures, avionics, ground support, safety/security.
W/S = mg/S (N/m²); kam W/S ⇒ kam stall speed.
T/W = kul thrust/(mg); airliner ≈ 0.25–0.4.
MTOW = empty + payload + fuel.
Flutter = aerodynamics + structures ka interaction.

questions.question: Wing ka flutter ek aisa vibration hai jo hawa ki forces aur wing ki elasticity ke milne se badhta jaata hai. Ise samajhne ke liye mainly kaun se do fields saath chahiye?
questions.explanation: Flutter mein aerodynamic forces wing ko modte hain, aur mudne se forces badal jaati hain; ye aerodynamics aur structures (elasticity) ka interaction hai, jise aeroelasticity kehte hain. Trap: koi bhi vibration engine se juda samajh kar propulsion chun lena.

questions.question: In mein se kaunsa kaam ground support field mein aata hai?
options: Wing ke liye airfoil choose karna
Autopilot ka control law design karna
Turbine blades ki cooling design karna
questions.explanation: Ground support mein woh sab aata hai jo vehicle ko zameen se chalaane mein madad kare: maintenance, refuelling, air traffic control, airports, launch site aur mission control. Airfoil choose karna aerodynamics, control law flight dynamics/control, aur turbine cooling propulsion ka kaam hai.

questions.question: Ek light aircraft ka mass 1,100 kg aur wing area 16.2 m² hai (g = 9.81 m/s²). Wing loading kya hai?
questions.explanation: W = 1,100 × 9.81 = 10,791 N. W/S = 10,791/16.2 ≈ 666 N/m². Trap: 67.9 asal mein kg/m² hai (g bhool gaye) par unit N/m² likhi hai; 1.50 × 10⁻³ ulta ratio S/W hai, aur 174,800 weight ko area se multiply karne par aata hai.

questions.question: Ek twin-engine airliner ke har engine ki thrust 120 kN hai aur take-off mass 75,000 kg hai (g = 9.81 m/s²). Take-off par thrust-to-weight ratio kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Kul thrust = 2 × 120 = 240 kN. Weight = 75,000 × 9.81 = 735,750 N. T/W = 240,000/735,750 ≈ 0.33. Trap: sirf ek engine lene par 0.16, g bhoolne par 3.2 (newton ko kg se divide kiya), aur ratio ulta lene par 3.07 aata hai.

questions.question: Ek aircraft ka MTOW 80,000 kg fixed hai. Operating empty weight 44,000 kg aur mission fuel 20,000 kg hai. Naye, zyada reliable avionics se empty weight 1,500 kg badh jaata hai, fuel same rehta hai. Ab maximum payload kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Pehle payload = 80,000 − 44,000 − 20,000 = 16,000 kg. Empty weight 45,500 kg hone par payload = 80,000 − 45,500 − 20,000 = 14,500 kg. Har extra kg structure/avionics MTOW fixed hone par seedha payload se katta hai. Trap: 17,500 kg tab aata hai jab 1,500 ko ghatane ki jagah jod do, aur 36,000 kg fuel bhool jaane par.

questions.question: Stall speed V_s = √(2W/(ρ S C_Lmax)). Weight aur C_Lmax same rakhte hue designer wing area 25% badha deta hai. Stall speed kitni badlegi?
questions.explanation: V_s ∝ 1/√S. Naya S = 1.25 S, to naya V_s = V_s/√1.25 = 0.894 V_s, yaani lagbhag 10.6% kam. Trap: square root bhool kar 1/1.25 = 0.8 lena (20% kam), ya seedha 25% kam maan lena. Fayda (kam stall speed) ke saath wing ka weight aur drag badhne ka nuksaan bhi aata hai.

weeks.title: Aerodynamics Primer: Airfoils, Lift and Drag
weeks.summary: Is week aap airfoil ke terms, lift aur drag ke formulas, angle of attack aur stall, aur Reynolds aur Mach number seekhoge, aur L = ½ρV²SC_L se lift, stall speed aur C_L calculate karoge.
concepts: **Airfoil terms**: wing ka cross-section airfoil hai. Aage ka gol hissa **leading edge**, peeche ka nukila hissa **trailing edge**, dono ko jodne wali seedhi line **chord** (length c). **Camber line** upper aur lower surface ke beech ki mean line hai; agar woh chord se upar mudi ho to airfoil cambered hai. Symmetric airfoil ka camber zero hota hai.

**Angle of attack (α)**: chord line aur aane wali hawa (relative wind) ke beech ka angle. Ye aircraft ke nose ki direction ya ground se angle nahi hai. Chhote α par C_L lagbhag α ke saath linearly badhta hai.

**Lift aur drag formulas**: L = ½ρV²SC_L aur D = ½ρV²SC_D. Yahan ½ρV² = **dynamic pressure** q (Pa), S = wing area, aur C_L, C_D dimensionless coefficients. Lift hawa ki direction ke perpendicular, drag hawa ki direction mein. V double ho to lift chaar guna.

**Lift kyun banti hai**: airfoil hawa ko neeche ki taraf modta hai, aur upper surface par pressure lower surface se kam ho jaata hai. Ye pressure difference hi lift hai. Efficiency ka measure **L/D ratio** hai; airliners cruise mein lagbhag 15–20 ka L/D paate hain.

**Stall**: α ek critical value (aksar 12°–18° ke aas-paas) se zyada hone par upper surface se flow separate ho jaata hai, C_L achanak girta hai aur drag badhta hai. Maximum C_L ko C_Lmax kehte hain. Level flight mein stall speed V_s = √(2W/(ρ S C_Lmax)). Flaps C_Lmax badhakar stall speed kam karte hain.

**Drag ke types**: **skin friction** (surface par viscous ragad), **pressure/form drag** (flow separation se), **induced drag** (lift banate waqt wingtip vortices se; kam speed par zyada), aur high speed par **wave drag** (shock waves se).

**Reynolds number**: Re = ρVL/μ, jahan L characteristic length (wing ke liye chord) aur μ hawa ki dynamic viscosity (sea level par lagbhag 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ Pa·s). Re inertia aur viscous forces ka ratio hai; full-size aircraft ka Re millions mein hota hai, chhote drones ka bahut kam, isliye unka aerodynamic behaviour alag hota hai.

**Mach number**: M = V/a, jahan a speed of sound hai (sea level ISA par lagbhag 340 m/s, 11 km par lagbhag 295 m/s). Regimes: subsonic (M < 0.8), transonic (lagbhag 0.8–1.2), supersonic (1.2–5), hypersonic (M > 5). M lagbhag 0.3 se upar compressibility effects ignore nahi kar sakte.

example.problem: Ek aircraft ka mass 1,200 kg aur wing area 16 m² hai. Sea level (ρ = 1.225 kg/m³) par 60 m/s se level flight ke liye kitna C_L chahiye? (g = 9.81 m/s²)
steps: Level flight mein L = W = 1,200 × 9.81 = 11,772 N.
Dynamic pressure q = ½ × 1.225 × 60² = ½ × 1.225 × 3,600 = 2,205 Pa.
Check: ye value typical C_Lmax (lagbhag 1.4–1.6) se kaafi kam hai, isliye aircraft stall se door hai.

mistakes: Lift formula mein ½ bhool jaana ya V ko square na karna. q = ½ρV²; speed double ho to lift 4 guna, 2 guna nahi.
Angle of attack ko nose ka ground se angle (pitch angle) samajhna. α chord line aur relative wind ke beech hota hai; climb mein pitch angle bada ho sakta hai jabki α chhota ho.
Mach number ke liye hamesha 340 m/s use kar lena. Speed of sound temperature par depend karti hai, isliye altitude par us altitude ki value lo.
revision: Chord: leading edge se trailing edge tak seedhi line.
L = ½ρV²SC_L, D = ½ρV²SC_D; q = ½ρV².
Critical α ke baad stall: C_L girta hai.
V_s = √(2W/(ρSC_Lmax)).
Re = ρVL/μ; M = V/a.

questions.question: Airfoil mein 'chord' kise kehte hain?
options: Upper aur lower surface ke beech ki mean curved line
Leading edge aur trailing edge ko jodne wali seedhi line
Ek wingtip se doosre wingtip tak ki doori
questions.explanation: Chord leading edge se trailing edge tak ki seedhi line hai aur angle of attack isi line se naapa jaata hai. Trap: mean curved line camber line hai, aur wingtip se wingtip ki doori wingspan hai.

questions.question: Density, wing area aur C_L same rakhte hue airspeed double kar di jaaye to lift kitni ho jaayegi?
questions.explanation: L = ½ρV²SC_L mein lift V² ke proportional hai. V double ⇒ V² chaar guna ⇒ lift 4 guna. Trap: lift ko V ke proportional maan kar 2 guna bol dena.

questions.question: Sea level (ρ = 1.225 kg/m³) par ek wing 50 m/s par ud raha hai. Wing area 16 m² aur C_L = 0.6 hai. Lift kitni hai?
questions.explanation: q = ½ × 1.225 × 50² = 1,531.25 Pa. L = q S C_L = 1,531.25 × 16 × 0.6 = 14,700 N. Trap: ½ bhool jaane par 29,400 N, V ko square na karne par 294 N, aur C_L bhool jaane par 24,500 N aata hai.

questions.question: Ek airliner 11 km par 250 m/s (true airspeed) se ud raha hai, jahan speed of sound 295 m/s hai. Uska Mach number kya hai?
questions.explanation: M = V/a = 250/295 ≈ 0.847, yaani high subsonic/transonic ke kinare. Trap: sea-level speed of sound 340 m/s use karne par 0.735 aata hai; 1.18 aur 1.36 ratio ulta lene se aate hain.

questions.question: Ek wing ka chord 1.2 m hai aur woh sea level par (ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, μ = 1.8 × 10⁻⁵ Pa·s) 40 m/s se ud raha hai. Chord ke basis par Reynolds number kya hai?
questions.explanation: Re = ρVc/μ = (1.225 × 40 × 1.2)/(1.8 × 10⁻⁵) = 58.8/(1.8 × 10⁻⁵) ≈ 3.27 × 10⁶. Trap: ρ bhool jaane par 2.67 × 10⁶ aata hai, aur ratio ulta (μ/ρVc) lene par 3.06 × 10⁻⁷, jo dimensionless to hai par Re nahi.

questions.question: Ek aircraft ka mass 1,000 kg, wing area 15 m² aur C_Lmax = 1.5 hai. Sea level (ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, g = 9.81 m/s²) par uski level-flight stall speed kya hai?
questions.explanation: W = 9,810 N. V_s = √(2W/(ρ S C_Lmax)) = √(19,620/(1.225 × 15 × 1.5)) = √(19,620/27.5625) = √711.8 ≈ 26.7 m/s. Trap: formula ka 2 bhoolne par 18.9 m/s, square root bhoolne par 712, aur g bhoolne (mass ko weight maanne) par 8.52 m/s aata hai.

weeks.title: Flight Dynamics and Control Basics
weeks.summary: Is week aap aircraft ke teen axes, pitch, roll aur yaw, control surfaces, static stability (CG, neutral point, static margin) aur trim seekhoge, aur moment balance se tail force nikaloge.
concepts: **Teen axes** (sab CG se guzarte hain): **longitudinal axis** (nose se tail) ke around motion **roll** hai; **lateral axis** (wingtip se wingtip) ke around **pitch**; **vertical (normal) axis** ke around **yaw**. Aircraft ke 6 degrees of freedom hain: teen translation aur teen rotation.

**Primary control surfaces**: **ailerons** (wing ke outer trailing edge par, ek upar ek neeche) roll dete hain; **elevator** (horizontal tail par) pitch deta hai; **rudder** (vertical tail par) yaw deta hai. Pilot stick left/right karta hai to ailerons, aage/peeche to elevator, aur pedals se rudder.

**Secondary controls**: **flaps** C_Lmax badhakar take-off/landing speed kam karte hain; **trim tabs** pilot ki lagaataar force ki zaroorat khatam karte hain; **spoilers** lift kam karke drag badhate hain (descent ya landing ke baad).

**Static stability**: disturbance ke turant baad aircraft ki **pehli tendency** apni original condition mein wapas aane ki ho to woh statically stable hai. Longitudinal stability ke liye CG **neutral point** (NP) se aage hona chahiye. **Static margin** SM = (x_NP − x_CG)/c̄; positive SM ⇒ stable, negative ⇒ unstable.

**Lateral aur directional stability**: wings ka **dihedral** (wingtips thode upar) roll disturbance ke baad wings level karne mein madad karta hai. **Vertical tail** weathercock ki tarah nose ko relative wind ki taraf rakhta hai, yaani directional (yaw) stability deta hai.

**Trim**: steady flight mein CG ke around saare moments ka sum zero aur saari forces balance. Conventional aircraft mein wing ki lift aksar CG se thoda peeche lagti hai (nose-down moment), isliye horizontal tail ko thoda **downward** force deni padti hai. Isse wing ko weight se thodi zyada lift banani padti hai.

**Dynamic stability aur control**: statically stable aircraft bhi disturbance ke baad oscillate kar sakta hai; agar oscillations dheere-dheere khatam hon to dynamically stable. Modern fighters aksar jaan-boojh kar kam ya negative stability ke saath design hote hain aur **fly-by-wire** computers unhe har pal control karte hain. Autopilot ek feedback loop hai: sensor → controller → actuator → aircraft → sensor.

example.problem: Ek aircraft ka weight 8,000 N hai. Wing ki lift CG se 0.1 m peeche lagti hai aur horizontal tail ki force CG se 4 m peeche. Baaki moments ignore karo. Trim ke liye tail force aur wing lift nikalo.
steps: Maan lo wing lift L_w (upar) aur tail force F_t (neeche). Vertical balance: L_w = W + F_t = 8,000 + F_t.
CG ke around moments: wing lift nose-down moment deti hai = 0.1 L_w; tail ki downward force nose-up moment deti hai = 4 F_t.
Answer: **tail ≈ 205 N downward, wing lift ≈ 8,205 N** (weight se thodi zyada, isi ko trim drag ka ek reason maana jaata hai).

mistakes: Axes aur motions mix karna: pitch lateral axis (wingtip se wingtip) ke around hota hai, longitudinal ke around nahi. Yaad rakho: jis axis ke around ghoomte ho, woh axis apni jagah rehta hai.
Static margin ka sign ulta lena. SM = (x_NP − x_CG)/c̄; CG NP se aage (chhota x) ho to SM positive aur aircraft stable.
CG ka shift chord ke fraction mein convert kiye bina jodna. Metres ko pehle mean chord c̄ se divide karo.
revision: Roll – longitudinal axis – ailerons.
Pitch – lateral axis – elevator.
Yaw – vertical axis – rudder.
Stable: CG neutral point se aage; SM = (x_NP − x_CG)/c̄ > 0.
Dihedral → roll stability; vertical tail → directional stability.
Trim: Σ moments about CG = 0.

questions.question: Pilot control stick ko left move karta hai. Kaunsa control surface kaam karega aur aircraft kis axis ke around ghoomega?
questions.explanation: Stick left-right ailerons chalata hai: ek aileron upar, doosra neeche, jisse ek wing ki lift badhti hai aur doosre ki ghatti hai, aur aircraft longitudinal axis ke around roll karta hai. Trap: aircraft ka turn hona dekh kar yaw/rudder sochna; turn roll (bank) se shuru hota hai.

questions.question: Pitch motion (nose upar-neeche) kis axis ke around hoti hai?
questions.explanation: Nose upar-neeche hone par wingtip se wingtip wali line apni jagah rehti hai, isliye pitch lateral axis ke around hai. Trap: 'nose' sun kar longitudinal axis chun lena; longitudinal axis ke around roll hota hai.

questions.question: Ek aircraft ka neutral point mean chord ke 0.42 c̄ par aur CG 0.28 c̄ par hai (dono leading edge se). Static margin aur stability kya hai?
questions.explanation: SM = (x_NP − x_CG)/c̄ = 0.42 − 0.28 = 0.14 = 14%. CG neutral point se aage hai, isliye aircraft statically stable hai. Trap: subtraction ulta karke −14% lena, ya 0.28/0.42 = 0.67 jaisa ratio le lena, jo static margin ki definition nahi hai.

questions.question: Ek aircraft mein wing lift 12,000 N hai aur CG se 0.15 m peeche lagti hai. Horizontal tail CG se 5 m peeche hai. Baaki moments ignore karo. Trim ke liye tail ko kitni force deni hogi?
questions.explanation: Wing ka nose-down moment = 12,000 × 0.15 = 1,800 N·m. Ise cancel karne ke liye tail ko nose-up moment chahiye; tail CG ke peeche hai, isliye uski force neeche honi chahiye: F = 1,800/5 = 360 N downward. Trap: 1,800 moment hai (N·m), force nahi; aur upward tail force nose-down moment ko aur badha degi.

questions.question: Agar kisi aircraft ka vertical tail bahut chhota kar diya jaaye, to sabse seedha asar kis stability par padega?
options: Koi stability nahi badlegi, sirf drag kam hoga
Lateral (roll) stability, jo dihedral se aati hai
questions.explanation: Vertical tail weathercock ki tarah kaam karta hai: sideslip hone par us par side force aati hai jo nose ko wapas relative wind ki taraf ghumati hai. Isliye chhota vertical tail directional (yaw) stability kam karta hai. Trap: pitch stability horizontal tail aur CG position se aati hai, aur roll stability mainly dihedral se.

questions.question: Ek aircraft ka mean chord c̄ = 2 m, neutral point 0.40 c̄ par aur shuru mein CG 0.25 c̄ par hai. Flight mein fuel jalne se CG 0.36 m peeche khisak jaata hai. Ab static margin aur stability kya hai?
questions.explanation: CG shift = 0.36/2 = 0.18 c̄, to naya CG = 0.25 + 0.18 = 0.43 c̄. SM = 0.40 − 0.43 = −0.03 = −3%, yaani CG neutral point ke peeche aa gaya aur aircraft statically unstable hai. Trap: 0.36 m ko chord se divide kiye bina seedha jodne par −21% aata hai, aur shift ignore karne par +15%.

weeks.title: Instruments and Sensors on Board
weeks.summary: Is week aap pitot-static system se airspeed aur altitude kaise naapte hain, IAS/CAS/EAS/TAS ka farq, attitude aur heading instruments, aur IMU aur GPS jaise modern sensors seekhoge.
concepts: **Pitot-static system**: **pitot tube** aage ki taraf khula hota hai aur **total (stagnation) pressure** p₀ naapta hai. **Static port** fuselage ki side par hota hai aur bahar ki hawa ka **static pressure** p naapta hai. Kam speed par p₀ − p = ½ρV², yaani dynamic pressure; isse V = √(2(p₀ − p)/ρ).

**Teen pitot-static instruments**: **airspeed indicator** (ASI) p₀ aur p dono leta hai; **altimeter** sirf static pressure leta hai aur ISA model se use altitude mein badalta hai; **vertical speed indicator** (VSI) static pressure ke badalne ki rate se climb/descent rate dikhata hai.

**Airspeeds**: **IAS** ASI par jo dikhta hai. **CAS** = IAS mein instrument aur position errors theek karke. **EAS** = CAS mein compressibility correction (high speed par zaroori). **TAS** = aircraft ki hawa ke relative asli speed: TAS = EAS × √(ρ₀/ρ). Upar jaane par ρ ghatta hai, isliye same EAS par TAS badhti hai. Ground speed = TAS + wind ka effect.

**Altimeter aur pressure**: sea level ke paas pressure lagbhag ρg ≈ 12 Pa per metre girta hai (hydrostatic: Δp = ρgΔh). Altimeter par reference pressure set karna padta hai; galat setting se dikhayi gayi altitude asli altitude se alag hogi.

**Blockages**: static port block ho jaaye to altimeter usi altitude par atak jaata hai aur VSI zero dikhata hai. Pitot tube (drain hole ke saath) block ho jaaye to ASI altimeter ki tarah behave karta hai: climb mein speed badhti dikhti hai, descent mein ghatti. Pitot heaters isiliye lagaaye jaate hain.

**Attitude aur heading**: **attitude indicator** (artificial horizon) pitch aur bank dikhata hai; **heading indicator** direction dikhata hai; **turn coordinator** turn rate aur balance. Ye traditionally gyroscopes par chalte the; magnetic compass backup hai par turn aur acceleration mein galat padhta hai.

**IMU aur GPS**: **IMU** mein accelerometers (linear acceleration) aur gyroscopes (angular rate) hote hain; inhe integrate karke attitude, velocity aur position milti hai, par chhote errors time ke saath **drift** ban jaate hain. **GPS/GNSS** satellites se position deta hai; 3D position aur receiver clock error ke liye kam se kam 4 satellites chahiye. Dono ko sensor fusion (jaise Kalman filter) se milaate hain: IMU fast aur smooth, GPS drift-free.
**Glass cockpit**: modern aircraft mein ye sab ek **air data computer** aur AHRS/INS se aata hai aur bade displays par dikhta hai, par principle wahi pitot-static aur inertial sensors ke hain.

example.problem: 3 km altitude par (ρ = 0.909 kg/m³) pitot-static system p₀ − p = 3,000 Pa naapta hai. ASI ρ₀ = 1.225 kg/m³ par calibrated hai. Errors aur compressibility ignore karke ASI ki reading (EAS) aur asli speed (TAS) nikalo.
steps: ASI sea-level density maan kar speed nikalta hai: EAS = √(2 × 3,000/1.225) = √4,898 ≈ 70.0 m/s.
Asli speed us altitude ki density se: TAS = √(2 × 3,000/0.909) = √6,601 ≈ 81.2 m/s.
Matlab altitude par pilot ko ASI 70 m/s dikhayega jabki aircraft hawa mein 81 m/s se chal raha hai.

mistakes: Altitude par bhi ASI ki reading ko true airspeed maan lena. ASI sea-level density se calibrated hai; TAS ke liye √(ρ₀/ρ) se multiply karo.
V = √(2Δp/ρ) mein 2 bhool jaana ya square root na lena. Dynamic pressure ½ρV² hai, isliye V = √(2Δp/ρ).
IMU ko permanent accurate samajhna. Accelerometer aur gyro ke errors integrate hokar badhte hain, isliye GPS ya doosre sensor se correction chahiye.
revision: Pitot = total pressure; static port = static pressure.
Altimeter sirf static pressure use karta hai; static block ⇒ altimeter frozen.
TAS = EAS × √(ρ₀/ρ).
Near sea level Δh ≈ Δp/(ρg), lagbhag 12 Pa per metre.
IMU = accelerometers + gyros (drift); GPS 3D fix ke liye 4 satellites.

questions.question: Aircraft ka pressure altimeter kaunsa pressure use karke altitude dikhata hai?
questions.explanation: Altimeter static port se bahar ki hawa ka static pressure leta hai aur standard atmosphere ke relation se use altitude mein badalta hai. Trap: total ya dynamic pressure speed par depend karte hain, isliye ve ASI ke kaam aate hain; cabin pressure andar ka hota hai aur bahar ki altitude nahi batata.

questions.question: IMU mein gyroscopes seedha kya naapte hain?
options: Angular rate (kitni tezi se ghoom raha hai)
questions.explanation: Gyroscopes angular rate (rad/s ya deg/s) naapte hain; ise integrate karke attitude milta hai. Linear acceleration accelerometers naapte hain, aur magnetic heading magnetometer ya compass deta hai. Trap: accelerometer aur gyro ke kaam ulat dena.

questions.question: Sea level par (ρ = 1.225 kg/m³) pitot aur static pressure ka difference 2,450 Pa hai. Airspeed kitni hai?
questions.explanation: V = √(2Δp/ρ) = √(2 × 2,450/1.225) = √4,000 ≈ 63.2 m/s. Trap: 2 bhool jaane par √2,000 = 44.7 m/s, square root bhoolne par 4,000, aur 2 ki jagah 4 lagane par 89.4 m/s aata hai.

questions.question: Ek aircraft ki equivalent airspeed (EAS) 80 m/s hai aur woh us altitude par hai jahan ρ = 0.736 kg/m³ (ρ₀ = 1.225 kg/m³). True airspeed kya hai?
questions.explanation: TAS = EAS × √(ρ₀/ρ) = 80 × √(1.225/0.736) = 80 × 1.290 ≈ 103 m/s. Patli hawa mein same dynamic pressure ke liye zyada asli speed chahiye. Trap: ratio ulta lene par 62.0 m/s, aur square root bhoolne par 133 m/s aata hai.

questions.question: Climb ke dauran static port barf se poori tarah block ho jaata hai (pitot tube theek hai). Altimeter kya dikhayega?
options: Blockage wali altitude par atak jaayega
Asli altitude se tezi se upar jaata dikhega
questions.explanation: Altimeter sirf static pressure par chalta hai. Port block hone par andar ka pressure wahi rehta hai jo blockage ke waqt tha, isliye altimeter usi altitude par atak jaata hai aur VSI zero dikhata hai. Trap: sochna ki koi pressure nahi milega to zero dikhega; andar band hawa ka pressure bana rehta hai.

questions.question: Sea level ke paas ek drone ka barometric sensor static pressure 101,325 Pa se 100,123 Pa girta dekhta hai. ρ = 1.225 kg/m³ aur g = 9.81 m/s² lekar (Δp = ρgΔh) drone kitna upar gaya?
questions.explanation: Δp = 101,325 − 100,123 = 1,202 Pa. Δh = Δp/(ρg) = 1,202/(1.225 × 9.81) = 1,202/12.02 ≈ 100 m. Trap: g bhool jaane par 981 m, ρg se multiply karne par lagbhag 14,400, aur 1 Pa ko 1 m maan lene par 1,202 m aata hai.

weeks.title: Propulsion: Engines, Thrust and Rockets
weeks.summary: Is week aap propulsion systems ki classification (piston-prop, turboprop, turbojet, turbofan, ramjet, rocket), thrust ka momentum formula, bypass ratio, propulsive efficiency, specific impulse aur Tsiolkovsky rocket equation seekhoge.
concepts: **Thrust ka basic idea**: engine hawa (ya gas) ko peeche ki taraf tez karta hai, aur Newton ke third law se reaction force aage lagti hai. Air-breathing engine ke liye F = ṁ(V_e − V₀) + (p_e − p_a)A_e, jahan ṁ mass flow rate, V_e exhaust velocity, V₀ flight speed. Nozzle ka pressure p_e = p_a ho to doosra term zero.

**Piston-prop aur turboprop**: piston engine ya gas turbine propeller ghumata hai, jo bahut saari hawa ko thoda sa tez karta hai. Kam speed par (lagbhag M 0.6–0.7 tak) bahut fuel-efficient, isliye trainers aur regional aircraft mein. Propeller tip ki speed high Mach par problem banti hai.

**Turbojet**: intake → compressor → combustor → turbine → nozzle (Brayton cycle). Turbine sirf compressor chalaane jitni energy leti hai; baaki gas tez jet ban kar nikalti hai. High jet velocity, high speed par achha par subsonic par fuel-hungry aur noisy.

**Turbofan**: aage ek bada fan jo kuch hawa core ke bahar se (bypass) bhejta hai. **Bypass ratio** (BPR) = bypass mass flow / core mass flow. Modern airliners ke high-BPR engines bahut hawa ko kam speed se dhakelte hain, isliye zyada efficient aur kam noisy. Fighters low-BPR turbofan aur **afterburner** use karte hain.

**Ramjet aur scramjet**: koi compressor nahi; tez forward speed se intake mein hi hawa compress hoti hai. Isliye ramjet zero speed par thrust nahi de sakta, use pehle booster se speed chahiye (lagbhag M 2–5 par achha). **Scramjet** mein combustion supersonic flow mein hota hai, hypersonic speeds ke liye.

**Rocket**: fuel aur oxidiser dono saath le jaata hai, isliye hawa ki zaroorat nahi aur vacuum mein bhi kaam karta hai. Thrust F = ṁV_e + (p_e − p_a)A_e. **Specific impulse** I_sp = F/(ṁg₀) seconds mein; bina pressure term ke I_sp = V_e/g₀. Zyada I_sp matlab propellant ka zyada efficient use. Types: solid, liquid, hybrid, aur electric (bahut high I_sp, bahut kam thrust).

**Propulsive efficiency**: η_p = 2/(1 + V_e/V₀). Jitna V_e flight speed ke kareeb, utna efficient, par thrust per kg hawa kam. Isliye same thrust ke liye zyada hawa ko kam tez karna (turbofan, propeller) efficient hai. Engine choose karte waqt sabse pehle speed aur altitude regime dekho. Kam speed → propeller; high subsonic → high-BPR turbofan; supersonic → low-BPR turbofan/turbojet with afterburner; M 3+ → ramjet/scramjet; space → rocket. Phir fuel efficiency, weight, cost, noise aur reliability dekhte hain.

**Tsiolkovsky rocket equation**: Δv = I_sp g₀ ln(m₀/m_f), jahan m₀ initial mass (propellant ke saath) aur m_f burnout mass. Mass ratio ka **natural log** aata hai, isliye Δv badhaane ke liye propellant bahut tezi se badhaana padta hai; isi liye rockets **staging** use karte hain (khaali stages gira dete hain).

example.problem: Ek aircraft 250 m/s par ud raha hai aur use 20 kN thrust chahiye. Option A: turbojet jiska V_e = 600 m/s. Option B: turbofan jiska average V_e = 350 m/s. Dono ke liye zaroori air mass flow aur propulsive efficiency nikalo (pressure thrust zero, fuel mass ignore).
steps: Turbojet: thrust per kg/s = 600 − 250 = 350 N·s/kg. ṁ = 20,000/350 ≈ 57.1 kg/s.
Turbofan: thrust per kg/s = 350 − 250 = 100 N·s/kg. ṁ = 20,000/100 = 200 kg/s.
Turbofan ko 3.5 guna zyada hawa chahiye (bada, bhaari fan), par efficiency kaafi zyada hai, isliye kam fuel.
Answer: **turbojet ≈ 57 kg/s, η_p ≈ 0.59; turbofan 200 kg/s, η_p ≈ 0.83**.

mistakes: Air-breathing engine ka thrust ṁV_e likh dena aur aane wali hawa ka momentum (ṁV₀) bhool jaana. Net thrust ṁ(V_e − V₀) hai; rocket mein V₀ wala term nahi hota kyunki woh hawa andar nahi leta.
Specific impulse nikalte waqt kN ko N mein convert na karna, ya g₀ se divide karna bhool jaana. I_sp = F/(ṁg₀), F newton mein.
Rocket equation mein ln ki jagah log₁₀ use karna ya mass ratio ko seedha multiply karna. Δv = I_sp g₀ ln(m₀/m_f).
revision: Air-breathing: F = ṁ(V_e − V₀) + (p_e − p_a)A_e.
Rocket: F = ṁV_e + (p_e − p_a)A_e; oxidiser saath, vacuum mein kaam.
BPR = bypass flow / core flow; high BPR ⇒ efficient, quiet.
Ramjet: compressor nahi, zero speed par thrust nahi.
I_sp = F/(ṁg₀) = V_e/g₀ (seconds).
Δv = I_sp g₀ ln(m₀/m_f).

questions.question: Kaunsa engine runway par khade aircraft (zero forward speed) ko thrust nahi de sakta?
questions.explanation: Ramjet mein compressor nahi hota; hawa ko compress karne ke liye vehicle ki tez forward speed chahiye. Zero speed par compression nahi hota, isliye thrust bhi nahi. Trap: rocket ko bhi air-breathing maan lena; rocket apna oxidiser le jaata hai aur zero speed par bhi thrust deta hai.

questions.question: Rocket engine space (vacuum) mein bhi kyun kaam karta hai?
options: Space mein drag nahi hota, isliye thrust ki zaroorat nahi
Woh fuel ke saath apna oxidiser bhi saath le jaata hai
Woh intake se oxygen leta hai
questions.explanation: Combustion ke liye fuel aur oxidiser dono chahiye. Rocket dono saath le jaata hai, isliye use bahar ki hawa nahi chahiye aur vacuum mein bhi gas ko peeche phenk kar thrust banata hai. Trap: drag na hone ka matlab ye nahi ki thrust ki zaroorat nahi; speed badhaane (Δv) ke liye thrust chahiye.

questions.question: Ek turbojet 220 m/s par ud raha hai. Air mass flow 80 kg/s aur exhaust velocity 520 m/s hai. Nozzle fully expanded hai aur fuel mass ignore karo. Net thrust kitna hai?
questions.explanation: F = ṁ(V_e − V₀) = 80 × (520 − 220) = 80 × 300 = 24,000 N = 24.0 kN. Trap: aane wali hawa ka momentum bhool kar ṁV_e = 41.6 kN lena, ya velocities jod kar 59.2 kN lena.

questions.question: Ek turbofan se kul 600 kg/s hawa guzarti hai aur uska bypass ratio 9 hai. Core (combustor wale hisse) se kitni hawa jaati hai?
questions.explanation: BPR = bypass/core = 9, to total = core + 9 × core = 10 × core. Core = 600/10 = 60 kg/s aur bypass = 540 kg/s. Trap: total ko seedha 9 se divide karke 66.7 kg/s lena, ya bypass flow (540) ko core samajhna.

questions.question: Ek rocket engine vacuum mein 750 kN thrust deta hai aur 250 kg/s propellant jalata hai. g₀ = 9.81 m/s² lekar specific impulse kya hai?
questions.explanation: I_sp = F/(ṁg₀) = 750,000/(250 × 9.81) = 750,000/2,452.5 ≈ 306 s. Effective exhaust velocity 3,000 m/s hai. Trap: 3,000 velocity (m/s) hai, seconds nahi; kN ko N mein convert na karne par 0.306 aata hai, aur g₀ se divide ki jagah multiply karne par 29,430.

questions.question: Ek rocket stage ka initial mass 50,000 kg aur burnout mass 12,500 kg hai. Engine ka I_sp = 300 s aur g₀ = 9.81 m/s². Tsiolkovsky equation se ideal Δv kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Mass ratio = 50,000/12,500 = 4. Δv = I_sp g₀ ln 4 = 300 × 9.81 × 1.386 ≈ 4,080 m/s = 4.08 km/s. Trap: ln ki jagah mass ratio se seedha multiply karne par 11.77 km/s, log₁₀ use karne par 1.77 km/s, aur g₀ bhoolne par 0.416 km/s aata hai.

weeks.title: Airframe Structures and Loads
weeks.summary: Is week aap airframe ke parts (fuselage, wing spars, ribs, skin, stringers, empennage, landing gear), unpar lagne wale loads, load factor, limit aur ultimate load, aur stress = F/A aur pressurised fuselage ka hoop stress seekhoge.
concepts: **Airframe components**: **fuselage** (body jismein crew, passengers, cargo), **wings**, **empennage** (tail: horizontal stabilizer + elevator, vertical stabilizer + rudder), **landing gear**, aur engine mounts/nacelles. Har part ka kaam alag loads ko surakshit tarah se le jaana hai.

**Wing ka andar ka structure**: **spars** wing ki length mein chalne wale main beams hain jo bending load uthate hain. **Ribs** chord-wise frames hain jo airfoil shape banaye rakhte hain aur skin ke loads spars tak pahunchate hain. **Skin** shear aur torsion leta hai, aur **stringers** skin ko stiff banakar buckling se bachaate hain.

**Monocoque vs semi-monocoque**: monocoque mein poora load sirf skin uthata hai (jaise ande ka chhilka). Aircraft mein aksar **semi-monocoque** hota hai: skin ke saath frames (ya bulkheads) aur stringers milkar load uthate hain, jisse halka aur damage-tolerant structure milta hai.

**Loads**: aerodynamic loads (lift, drag, tail loads), weight aur inertia, engine thrust, landing impact, gusts, aur **cabin pressurisation**. Pressurised fuselage ek pressure vessel hai: hoop (circumferential) stress σ = Δp·r/t aur longitudinal stress iska aadha, Δp·r/(2t).

**Load factor**: n = L/W. Steady level flight mein n = 1. Level banked turn mein n = 1/cos φ, isliye 60° bank par n = 2, yaani structure ko apne weight ka do guna lift sehna padta hai aur pilot ko bhi 2g feel hota hai. Gusts aur pull-up manoeuvres n ko aur badhate hain.

**Limit aur ultimate load**: **limit load** sabse bada load jo service mein expected hai, us par structure bina permanent deformation ke rehna chahiye. **Ultimate load** = limit × factor of safety; aviation mein aam factor of safety **1.5** hai, aur ultimate load par structure ko kam se kam kuch seconds tootna nahi chahiye.

**Stress aur strain**: normal stress σ = F/A (Pa; 1 MPa = 10⁶ Pa = 1 N/mm²). Strain ε = change in length / original length. Elastic region mein σ = Eε (Hooke's law). Design mein stress material ke allowable stress se kam rakha jaata hai.

**Landing gear**: **tricycle** (nose wheel + do main wheels, aaj sabse common, ground par stable aur achhi visibility) aur **tail-dragger** (tail wheel). Shock absorber (oleo strut) landing ki energy absorb karta hai.

example.problem: Ek aircraft ki ek taraf ki wing (half-wing) level flight mein 40 kN lift banati hai, jo root se effectively 3.5 m door lagti hai. Root bending moment level flight mein aur limit load factor n = 2.5 par nikalo. Factor of safety 1.5 lekar ultimate design moment kya hoga?
steps: Level flight (n = 1): M = F × d = 40 × 3.5 = 140 kN·m.
Load factor n = 2.5 par lift 2.5 guna: 100 kN, to limit moment = 100 × 3.5 = 350 kN·m.
Matlab wing spar ko normal flight se lagbhag 3.75 guna moment ke liye design karna padta hai.

mistakes: Area ko mm² ya cm² se m² mein galat convert karna. 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m², 1 mm² = 10⁻⁶ m²; ya phir N/mm² seedha MPa hai.
Turn mein load factor ko 1/sin φ ya cos φ lena. Level turn mein n = 1/cos φ: 60° par 2, 45° par lagbhag 1.41.
Hoop stress mein radius ki jagah diameter daal dena, ya hoop aur longitudinal mix karna. Hoop = Δp·r/t, longitudinal = Δp·r/(2t).
revision: Spars: bending; ribs: shape; skin: shear/torsion; stringers: buckling se bachaav.
Semi-monocoque: skin + frames + stringers saath load lete hain.
n = L/W; level turn n = 1/cos φ.
Ultimate = limit × 1.5.
σ = F/A; hoop = Δp·r/t.

questions.question: Wing structure mein ribs ka main kaam kya hai?
options: Wing ka main bending load poori span mein uthana
Airfoil ki shape banaye rakhna aur skin ke loads spars tak pahunchana
questions.explanation: Ribs chord-wise frames hain jo airfoil ka shape banaye rakhte hain, skin aur stringers ko support karte hain aur unke loads spars tak transfer karte hain. Trap: main bending load spar uthata hai, rib nahi; landing ke jhatke landing gear ka shock absorber leta hai.

questions.question: Semi-monocoque fuselage mein load kaun uthata hai?
options: Skin ke saath frames aur stringers milkar
questions.explanation: Semi-monocoque mein patli skin akele load nahi uthati; frames aur stringers use support karte hain aur sab milkar load share karte hain. Trap: 'sirf skin' pure monocoque ki definition hai.

questions.question: 1,200 kg ka ek aircraft 60° bank par level turn kar raha hai (g = 9.81 m/s²). Wings ko kitni lift banani padegi?
questions.explanation: Level turn mein n = 1/cos 60° = 2. W = 1,200 × 9.81 = 11,772 N, to L = nW = 23,544 N. Trap: n = 1 lekar sirf weight (11,772 N) likhna; 13,593 N tab aata hai jab cos 30° use kar do, aur 2,400 g bhoolne par.

questions.question: Landing gear ka ek strut 60 kN ka axial load leta hai aur uska cross-section area 5 cm² hai. Strut mein normal stress kitna hai?
questions.explanation: A = 5 cm² = 5 × 10⁻⁴ m². σ = F/A = 60,000/(5 × 10⁻⁴) = 1.2 × 10⁸ Pa = 120 MPa. Trap: cm² ko 10⁻³ ya 10⁻⁵ se convert karne par 12 ya 1,200 MPa aata hai, aur kN ko N mein na badalne par 0.12 MPa.

questions.question: Ek aircraft ka positive limit load factor 3.8 hai aur factor of safety 1.5 hai. Structure ko kis ultimate load factor ke liye design karna hoga?
questions.explanation: Ultimate = limit × factor of safety = 3.8 × 1.5 = 5.7. Trap: 3.8 ko 1.5 se divide karne par 2.53, aur jodne par 5.3 aata hai; factor of safety multiply hota hai.

questions.question: Ek pressurised fuselage ka radius 1.9 m aur skin thickness 1.6 mm hai. Cabin aur bahar ke pressure ka difference 55 kPa hai. Skin mein hoop stress (σ = Δp·r/t) kitna hai?
questions.explanation: σ = 55,000 × 1.9/0.0016 = 6.53 × 10⁷ Pa ≈ 65.3 MPa. Trap: 32.7 MPa longitudinal stress hai (Δp·r/(2t)); thickness ko mm mein hi daalne par 0.0653 MPa, aur radius ki jagah diameter lene par 130.6 MPa aata hai.

weeks.title: Aerospace Materials
weeks.summary: Is week aap aerospace mein use hone wale materials (aluminium alloys, titanium, steel, composites), specific strength aur specific stiffness, aur fatigue aur corrosion jaise failure modes seekhoge, aur numbers se material choose karoge.
concepts: **Material choose karne ke criteria**: strength, stiffness, density (weight), fatigue resistance, fracture toughness, corrosion resistance, temperature capability, manufacturing aur cost. Aerospace mein weight sabse costly cheez hai, isliye properties ko density se divide karke compare karte hain.

**Specific strength aur specific stiffness**: specific strength = σ/ρ aur specific stiffness = E/ρ. Ek interesting fact: steel, aluminium aur titanium teeno ki E/ρ lagbhag same (≈ 25 MN·m/kg) hai, isliye metal badalne se stiffness per kg zyada nahi badhti. Carbon-fibre composites isme kaafi aage hain.

**Aluminium alloys**: halke (ρ ≈ 2,800 kg/m³), sasti machining, achhi strength; airliners ke airframe ka bada hissa. 2xxx series (jaise 2024) achhi fatigue aur damage tolerance ke liye lower wing skin aur fuselage mein; 7xxx series (jaise 7075) high strength ke liye upper wing aur heavily loaded parts mein. Limit: lagbhag 150 °C se upar strength girti hai.

**Titanium aur steel**: titanium alloys (jaise Ti-6Al-4V, ρ ≈ 4,430 kg/m³) high strength, high temperature aur corrosion resistance dete hain: engine ke garam parts ke paas, landing gear ke parts, fasteners. Mehenga aur machine karna mushkil. High-strength steel bahut strong par bhaari; landing gear jaise compact high-load parts mein.

**Composites**: fibres (carbon, glass, aramid) ek matrix (aksar epoxy) mein. **CFRP** ki specific strength aur stiffness bahut high, fatigue aur corrosion achha. Ye **anisotropic** hote hain: fibre direction mein strong, across weak, isliye layers alag angles par lagaate hain. Boeing 787 jaise naye airliners mein structure ka lagbhag aadha weight composites ka hai. Limit: impact damage andar chhupa reh sakta hai, repair aur inspection mushkil.

**Fatigue**: bar-bar lagne wale (cyclic) loads, jaise har flight mein cabin pressurisation, se static strength se kam stress par bhi chhote cracks banke badhte hain aur part toot sakta hai. **S-N curve** batata hai kis stress par kitne cycles tak part chalega. Steel ki aksar endurance limit hoti hai, aluminium ki nahi. 1950s ke Comet jet accidents ne pressurised fuselage mein fatigue ka mahatva dikhaya.

**Miner's rule (cumulative damage)**: agar part n₁ cycles kisi stress par chalaya jiski life N₁ hai, aur n₂ cycles doosre stress par (life N₂), to damage D = n₁/N₁ + n₂/N₂ + ... D = 1 hone par failure expected. Ye simple linear estimate hai.

**Corrosion**: nami aur namak se metals mein jung. **Galvanic corrosion** tab hota hai jab do alag electrochemical potential wale materials (jaise CFRP aur aluminium) nami mein contact mein hon; aluminium jaldi corrode hota hai. Isliye CFRP ke saath titanium fasteners, insulating layers aur sealants use hote hain.

example.problem: Teen materials compare karo: Al alloy (σ = 500 MPa, E = 72 GPa, ρ = 2,800 kg/m³), Ti alloy (σ = 900 MPa, E = 110 GPa, ρ = 4,430 kg/m³), CFRP fibre direction mein (σ = 1,500 MPa, E = 135 GPa, ρ = 1,600 kg/m³). Specific strength aur specific stiffness nikalo.
steps: Ti ki specific strength Al se thodi zyada, par specific stiffness lagbhag same; CFRP dono mein lagbhag 3 se 5 guna aage (fibre direction mein).
Isliye jahan weight aur stiffness critical hain (wing skin, control surfaces), wahan composites choose karte hain, aur jahan temperature ya concentrated loads hain, wahan titanium.

mistakes: Sirf strength ya E dekh kar material choose karna. Aerospace mein property ko density se divide karo; steel ka E bada hai par uska E/ρ aluminium jitna hi hai.
Composite ki fibre-direction property ko har direction mein maan lena. Composites anisotropic hain; across fibres strength bahut kam hoti hai.
Fatigue ko sirf bade loads ka issue samajhna. Chhote par lakhon baar aane wale loads bhi crack badha dete hain, isliye inspection intervals rakhte hain.
revision: Specific strength = σ/ρ, specific stiffness = E/ρ.
Steel, Al, Ti: E/ρ ≈ 25 MN·m/kg; CFRP kaafi zyada.
2024: fatigue/damage tolerance; 7075: high strength.
Fatigue: cyclic load, S-N curve; Miner: D = Σ n/N.
CFRP + aluminium + nami ⇒ galvanic corrosion.

questions.question: Ek CFRP panel ko seedha aluminium fasteners se jodne mein (nami wale environment mein) sabse badi problem kya hai?
options: Galvanic corrosion: aluminium jaldi corrode hota hai
Koi problem nahi, dono halke materials hain
questions.explanation: Carbon fibre aur aluminium ke electrochemical potential mein bada farq hai; nami mein contact se galvanic cell banta hai aur aluminium (anode) jaldi corrode hota hai. Isliye CFRP ke saath titanium fasteners ya insulation use karte hain. Trap: dono halke hain to compatible bhi honge, ye maan lena.

questions.question: Material ke context mein 'fatigue failure' kya hai?
options: Bar-bar lagne wale (cyclic) load se, static strength se kam stress par bhi crack badhna aur part ka tootna
Ek hi baar ke bahut bade load se turant tootna
Bahut zyada temperature se material ka pighalna
Paani se metal par jung lagna
questions.explanation: Fatigue mein har load cycle crack ko thoda badhata hai, aur hazaaron-lakhon cycles ke baad part toot sakta hai, chahe har cycle ka stress static strength se kaafi kam ho. Trap: ek baar ke overload se tootna static failure hai, aur jung corrosion hai.

questions.question: Al alloy: σ = 500 MPa, ρ = 2,800 kg/m³. Ti alloy: σ = 900 MPa, ρ = 4,430 kg/m³. Specific strength (σ/ρ) ke basis par kaunsa statement sahi hai?
options: Al ki zyada hai (lagbhag 179 vs 113 kN·m/kg)
Ti ki zyada hai (lagbhag 203 vs 179 kN·m/kg)
Ti ki strength zyada hai, par specific strength Al ki lagbhag 2 guna hai
Dono ki specific strength barabar hai
questions.explanation: Al: 500 × 10⁶/2,800 ≈ 179 kN·m/kg. Ti: 900 × 10⁶/4,430 ≈ 203 kN·m/kg. Ti thoda aage hai, par strength ke 1.8 guna farq ke muqaable specific strength mein sirf lagbhag 14% ka farq hai, kyunki Ti bhaari bhi hai. Trap: density ko bahut bada samajh kar Al ko aage maan lena.

questions.question: Steel (E = 200 GPa, ρ = 7,850 kg/m³), Al (E = 72 GPa, ρ = 2,800 kg/m³), Ti (E = 110 GPa, ρ = 4,430 kg/m³) aur CFRP fibre direction mein (E = 135 GPa, ρ = 1,600 kg/m³). Specific stiffness (E/ρ) ke baare mein kaunsa statement sahi hai?
options: Steel ka E sabse bada hai, isliye uski specific stiffness bhi sabse zyada hai
Al ki specific stiffness steel se lagbhag 3 guna hai
Ti ki specific stiffness CFRP se zyada hai
Teeno metals lagbhag 25 MN·m/kg par hain, jabki CFRP lagbhag 84 MN·m/kg par
questions.explanation: Steel 200/7.85 ≈ 25.5, Al 72/2.8 ≈ 25.7, Ti 110/4.43 ≈ 24.8 MN·m/kg, yaani teeno metals lagbhag barabar. CFRP 135/1.6 ≈ 84.4 MN·m/kg. Trap: sirf E dekh kar steel ko aage maanna; uski density bhi utni hi zyada hai. Al ki E steel se 3 guna kam hai, specific stiffness 3 guna zyada nahi.

questions.question: Ek tension member aluminium (σ_allow = 500 MPa, ρ = 2,800 kg/m³) se banaa hai aur uska mass 12 kg hai. Same load aur same length ke liye use titanium (σ_allow = 900 MPa, ρ = 4,430 kg/m³) se banaya jaaye (area = load/σ_allow), to naya mass kitna hoga?
questions.explanation: Same load ke liye area ∝ 1/σ, aur mass = ρ × area × length, to mass ∝ ρ/σ. Naya mass = 12 × (4,430/900)/(2,800/500) = 12 × 4.922/5.6 ≈ 10.5 kg. Trap: sirf density ka ratio lene par 19.0 kg, sirf strength ka ratio lene par 6.67 kg aata hai; dono saath lagte hain.

questions.question: Ek fitting 30,000 cycles ek stress level par chal chuki hai jahan uski fatigue life 150,000 cycles hai, aur 8,000 cycles ek zyada stress level par jahan life 20,000 cycles hai. Miner's rule (D = Σ n/N, failure D = 1 par) se, zyada stress level par aur kitne cycles chal sakti hai?
questions.explanation: D ab tak = 30,000/150,000 + 8,000/20,000 = 0.2 + 0.4 = 0.6. Bacha hua damage = 1 − 0.6 = 0.4. Zyada stress par cycles = 0.4 × 20,000 = 8,000. Trap: used damage 0.6 ko remaining samajh kar 12,000 lena, pehle ke cycles ignore karke 20,000 lena, ya kam stress wali life (150,000) se multiply karke 60,000 lena.

weeks.title: Satellites, Orbits and Space Robotics
weeks.summary: Is week aap satellite orbits (LEO, MEO, GEO, sun-synchronous), orbital speed v = √(GM/r) aur period, Kepler ka third law, escape speed, aur space robotics (robotic arms, rovers, time delay aur autonomy) seekhoge.
concepts: **Orbit kyun banta hai**: satellite lagaataar Earth ki taraf gir raha hai, par uski sideways speed itni hai ki Earth ki surface bhi utni hi mud jaati hai. Circular orbit mein gravity hi centripetal force deti hai: GMm/r² = mv²/r ⇒ **v = √(GM/r)**, jahan r Earth ke centre se doori hai (R_earth + altitude). GM_earth = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s².
**Period**: T = 2πr/v = 2π√(r³/GM). Ye **Kepler ka third law** hai: T² ∝ r³. Orbit jitna upar, speed utni kam aur period utna lamba. Low orbit (400 km) par v ≈ 7.7 km/s aur period ≈ 92 min.

**Orbit types**: **LEO** (lagbhag 160–2,000 km): imaging, space station, kam signal delay, par ek satellite thodi der hi ek jagah dikhta hai. **MEO** (2,000 km se GEO ke neeche): navigation constellations jaise GPS (lagbhag 20,200 km). **GEO** (35,786 km altitude, equator ke upar, period ek sidereal day ≈ 23 h 56 min): communication aur weather, ground se ruka hua dikhta hai.

**Sun-synchronous aur doosre orbits**: sun-synchronous orbit lagbhag polar LEO hai jo har jagah ke upar same local solar time par aata hai, isliye Earth observation ke liye favourite. **Geosynchronous transfer orbit (GTO)** ek elliptical orbit hai jismein launch vehicle GEO satellites ko chhodta hai; satellite apne engine se baad mein circular GEO banata hai.

**Escape speed**: kisi doori r se gravity ko poori tarah chhodne ke liye v_esc = √(2GM/r) = √2 × circular speed. Earth ki surface se ye lagbhag 11.2 km/s hai. Circular orbit se escape ke liye extra Δv = (√2 − 1) × v_circular.

**Satellite ke subsystems**: payload (camera, transponder), power (solar panels + batteries), attitude determination and control (sensors, reaction wheels, thrusters), thermal control, communication, propulsion, aur structure. Har subsystem ka mass aur power budget hota hai.

**Space robotics**: space station par **robotic arms** (jaise Canadarm2) cargo pakadte aur modules jodte hain; **rovers** (jaise Chandrayaan-3 ka Pragyan rover Moon par) surface explore karte hain; aur in-orbit servicing, refuelling aur docking ke liye bhi robots. Faayda: insaan ko khatarnaak jagah bheje bina kaam.

**Time delay aur autonomy**: signal light speed (3 × 10⁵ km/s) se jaata hai. Moon tak lagbhag 1.3 s one-way, par Mars tak kai minute. Itne delay mein Earth se joystick control possible nahi, isliye door ke robots ko **autonomy** chahiye: khud obstacle dekhna, rasta plan karna aur sirf high-level commands lena.

example.problem: GEO satellite ka period ek sidereal day = 86,164 s hai. GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s² lekar GEO orbit ka radius, altitude (Earth ka equatorial radius 6,378 km) aur orbital speed nikalo.
steps: v = √(GM/r) = √((3.986 × 10¹⁴)/(4.216 × 10⁷)) ≈ 3,075 m/s ≈ 3.07 km/s, jo LEO ki 7.7 km/s se kaafi kam hai.
Answer: **r ≈ 42,164 km, altitude ≈ 35,786 km, v ≈ 3.07 km/s**.

mistakes: v = √(GM/r) mein r ki jagah sirf altitude daal dena. r = R_earth + altitude, Earth ke centre se.
km ko m mein convert kiye bina GM (m³/s²) ke saath use karna. GM SI units mein hai, isliye r bhi metres mein lo.
Sochna ki upar wala satellite zyada tez chalta hai. Ulta hai: r badhne par v ghatti hai aur period badhta hai.
revision: v = √(GM/r), r = R_earth + h.
T = 2π√(r³/GM); T² ∝ r³.
LEO ≈ 7.7 km/s, ≈ 90 min; GEO 35,786 km, ≈ 23 h 56 min.
v_esc = √2 × v_circular; surface se ≈ 11.2 km/s.
Door ke robots: communication delay ⇒ autonomy zaroori.

questions.question: Ek GEO satellite ground se aasmaan mein ek hi jagah ruka hua kyun dikhta hai?
options: Woh equator ke upar, Earth ki rotation ki direction mein, ek sidereal day ke period se ghoomta hai
Woh orbit mein ruk jaata hai kyunki wahan gravity balance ho jaati hai
Woh polar orbit mein hai jo Earth ke saath ghoomta hai
Woh itna door hai ki wahan gravity zero ho jaati hai
questions.explanation: GEO satellite ka period Earth ki rotation (23 h 56 min) ke barabar hai, aur woh equatorial plane mein usi direction mein ghoomta hai, isliye ground ke saath-saath chalta hai. Woh lagbhag 3.07 km/s se chal raha hai, ruka nahi. Trap: gravity zero maan lena; 42,164 km par bhi gravity hai aur wahi satellite ko orbit mein rakhti hai.

questions.question: LEO mein ek satellite ki orbital speed GEO satellite ki speed se kaisi hogi?
options: Kam, kyunki LEO mein hawa ka thoda drag hai
Barabar, kyunki sab satellites ki speed same hoti hai
Zyada, kyunki v = √(GM/r) mein r chhota hai
questions.explanation: v = √(GM/r): r chhota ⇒ v zyada. LEO mein lagbhag 7.7 km/s, GEO mein lagbhag 3.1 km/s. Trap: formula mein r ko numerator mein samajh kar 'kam' bolna; drag speed ka main reason nahi hai, woh sirf dheere-dheere orbit ko neeche laata hai.

questions.question: Ek satellite 500 km altitude par circular orbit mein hai. GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s² aur R_earth = 6,371 km lekar uski orbital speed kya hai?
questions.explanation: r = 6,371 + 500 = 6,871 km = 6.871 × 10⁶ m. v = √((3.986 × 10¹⁴)/(6.871 × 10⁶)) ≈ 7,617 m/s ≈ 7.62 km/s. Trap: r ki jagah sirf altitude (500 km) lene par 28.2 km/s, R_earth hi lene par 7.91 km/s, aur km ko m mein na badalne par 241 km/s.

questions.question: Usi satellite (r = 6,871 km, v ≈ 7,617 m/s) ka orbital period kitna hai?
questions.explanation: T = 2πr/v = 2π × 6.871 × 10⁶/7,617 ≈ 5,668 s ≈ 94.5 min. Trap: 2π bhool kar r/v lene par 15.0 min, r ki jagah R_earth lene par 87.6 min, aur seconds ko minutes likh dene par 5,669.

questions.question: Ek satellite ka circular orbit radius (Earth ke centre se) 4 guna kar diya jaaye. Kepler ke third law se uska period kitne guna hoga?
questions.explanation: T² ∝ r³ ⇒ T ∝ r^(3/2). r 4 guna ⇒ T = 4^(3/2) = (√4)³ = 2³ = 8 guna. Trap: T ko r ke proportional maan kar 4 guna, ya T² ∝ r³ ko T ∝ r² samajh kar 16 guna lena.

questions.question: Ek spacecraft 400 km altitude par circular orbit mein hai (r = 6,771 km, GM = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s²). Isi jagah se Earth ki gravity se escape karne ke liye kam se kam kitna extra Δv chahiye (ek hi tez burn, orbit ki direction mein)?
questions.explanation: v_circ = √((3.986 × 10¹⁴)/(6.771 × 10⁶)) ≈ 7.67 km/s. v_esc = √2 × 7.67 ≈ 10.85 km/s. Extra Δv = 10.85 − 7.67 ≈ 3.18 km/s, kyunki spacecraft pehle se 7.67 km/s par chal raha hai. Trap: poori escape speed (10.85) ko Δv maan lena, ya surface wali escape speed (11.19 km/s) use karna.

weeks.title: Safety and Security in Aerospace
weeks.summary: Is week aap safety aur security ka farq, redundancy aur reliability ke calculations, certification ka idea, human factors, accident investigation, aur cyber aur physical security seekhoge.
concepts: **Safety vs security**: **safety** unintentional hazards se bachaav hai, jaise technical failure, weather, bird strike ya human error. **Security** jaan-boojh kar kiye gaye nuksaan se bachaav hai, jaise hijacking, sabotage, GPS spoofing ya cyber attack. Dono ke tools alag hain, par goal ek: log aur vehicle surakshit rahein.

**Redundancy**: critical functions ke liye ek se zyada independent channels, jaise do-teen hydraulic systems, multiple flight computers, do engines. Agar har channel ki failure probability p hai aur channels independent hain, to sab ke fail hone ki probability pⁿ. Series system (sab parts chalne zaroori) ki reliability R = r₁ × r₂ × ...; parallel (koi ek chale to kaafi) ki R = 1 − (1 − r)ⁿ.

**Common-mode failure aur voting**: agar saare channels mein same software bug, same power source ya same jagah se wiring ho, to ek hi cause sabko gira sakta hai; tab redundancy kaam nahi aati. Isliye **dissimilar redundancy** (alag hardware/software) aur physical separation use karte hain. Triplex systems aksar **2-out-of-3 voting** karte hain: R = 3r² − 2r³.

**Certification**: naya aircraft design ek regulator ko dikhana padta hai ki woh safety rules (airworthiness standards) poore karta hai; tab **type certificate** milta hai. Har individual aircraft ko **certificate of airworthiness** aur regular maintenance chahiye. India mein civil aviation regulator **DGCA** hai, aur international standards **ICAO** set karta hai.

**Human factors**: zyadatar accidents mein kahin na kahin human element hota hai: fatigue, galat communication, overconfidence, distraction. Bachaav: checklists, **Crew Resource Management (CRM)** (crew ka ek doosre ko challenge karna aur kaam baantna), simulator training, achha cockpit design aur automation ka samajhdari se use.

**Swiss cheese model**: har defence layer (design, maintenance, training, procedures, ATC) mein kuch chhed (weaknesses) hote hain. Accident tab hota hai jab kai layers ke chhed ek line mein aa jaate hain. Isliye ek accident ke peeche aksar kai factors hote hain, sirf ek galti nahi.

**Accident investigation**: aim blame lagana nahi, balki cause samajh kar dobara hone se rokna hai. **Flight data recorder (FDR)** parameters record karta hai aur **cockpit voice recorder (CVR)** cockpit ki awaaz; dono ko 'black box' kehte hain par asal mein orange rang ke hote hain taaki milne mein aasaan hon. India mein **AAIB** aircraft accidents investigate karta hai.

**Cyber aur physical security**: modern avionics, ADS-B, datalinks aur GNSS par jamming/spoofing ka khatra; bachaav ke liye networks ka segregation, authentication aur backup navigation. Physical security: passenger aur cargo screening, airport access control, reinforced cockpit doors, aur launch sites aur ground stations ki suraksha.

example.problem: Ek flight control function teen independent computers se chalta hai. Har computer ki ek flight mein sahi chalne ki probability r = 0.99 hai. (a) Agar koi bhi ek computer kaafi ho, (b) agar 2-out-of-3 voting chahiye, to system reliability kya hogi?
steps: (a) Parallel: system fail tab hoga jab teeno fail hon: (1 − 0.99)³ = (0.01)³ = 10⁻⁶.
(b) 2-out-of-3: kam se kam do computers sahi chalne chahiye: R = 3r² − 2r³.
Voting thodi kam reliability deta hai par galat output dene wale ek computer ko pakad leta hai; isliye flight control mein ye common hai.

mistakes: Redundant channels ki failure probabilities ko jod dena. Independent channels ke liye sab fail hone ki probability multiply hoti hai: p × p × p.
Maan lena ki teen identical computers hamesha teen guna safe hain. Common-mode failure (same bug, same power) teeno ko ek saath gira sakta hai.
Accident investigation ko blame dhoondhna samajhna. Uska aim hai cause samajh kar recommendations dena taaki aisa dobara na ho.
revision: Safety: unintentional hazards; security: jaan-boojh kar nuksaan.
Parallel independent: P(sab fail) = pⁿ; series: R = r₁r₂...
2-out-of-3: R = 3r² − 2r³.
Type certificate (design), certificate of airworthiness (har aircraft); DGCA, ICAO.
Investigation ka aim: prevention, blame nahi; FDR + CVR.

questions.question: In mein se kaunsa security ka issue hai, safety ka nahi?
options: Kisi ka jaan-boojh kar GPS signal spoof karna
questions.explanation: Security jaan-boojh kar kiye gaye nuksaan se judi hai; GPS spoofing ek intentional attack hai. Bird strike, fatigue se galti aur metal fatigue sab unintentional hazards hain, isliye safety ke issues hain. Trap: 'fatigue' shabd dono jagah aane se confuse hona.

questions.question: Aircraft accident investigation ka main aim kya hai?
options: Zimmedaar vyakti ko dhoondh kar saza dilwana
Cause samajh kar aise accidents ko dobara hone se rokna
Airline ke insurance claim ka amount tay karna
questions.explanation: International practice mein safety investigation ka maqsad prevention hai: kya hua aur kyun hua samajh kar safety recommendations dena. Blame aur liability alag processes hain. Trap: news mein blame par focus dekh kar use investigation ka aim samajh lena.

questions.question: Ek aircraft mein teen independent hydraulic systems hain. Har ek ke ek flight hour mein fail hone ki probability 10⁻⁴ hai. Teeno ke ek saath fail hone ki probability kya hai?
questions.explanation: Independent events ke liye P(teeno fail) = 10⁻⁴ × 10⁻⁴ × 10⁻⁴ = 10⁻¹². Trap: probabilities jodne par 3 × 10⁻⁴ (ye 'kam se kam ek fail' ka approximate answer hai), aur sirf do systems lene par 10⁻⁸ aata hai.

questions.question: Ek navigation chain mein 4 components series mein hain (sab chalne zaroori). Har component ki reliability 0.98 hai. Poori chain ki reliability kya hai?
questions.explanation: Series system: R = 0.98⁴ = 0.98 × 0.98 × 0.98 × 0.98 ≈ 0.922. Har extra series component reliability ghatata hai. Trap: 0.99999984 parallel system ka answer hai (1 − 0.02⁴), aur 3.92 reliabilities jodne se aata hai, jo 1 se zyada hone ki wajah se possible hi nahi.

questions.question: Teen identical flight computers bilkul same software chalate hain. Kis tarah ki failure se ye triple redundancy bachaa nahi paayegi?
options: Ek computer ka power supply fail hona
Ek computer ke chip mein random hardware fault
Software ka ek bug jo teeno mein same input par trigger hota hai (common-mode failure)
Ek computer ka connector dheela hona
questions.explanation: Same software ka bug teeno computers mein ek saath, same input par aayega, to voting bhi teeno ko galat paayegi; ye common-mode failure hai. Ek computer ki random fault ko baaki do outvote kar dete hain. Isliye critical systems mein dissimilar software/hardware use karte hain. Trap: maan lena ki teen copies har failure se bachaati hain.

questions.question: Ek triplex sensor system 2-out-of-3 voting use karta hai (kam se kam do sensors sahi hone chahiye). Har sensor ki reliability 0.95 hai aur sensors independent hain. System reliability kya hai?
questions.explanation: R = 3r² − 2r³ = 3 × 0.9025 − 2 × 0.857375 = 2.7075 − 1.71475 ≈ 0.993. Trap: 0.857 = 0.95³ hai (teeno sahi chahiye), aur 0.999875 = 1 − 0.05³ hai (koi ek sahi kaafi), jo voting system ki condition nahi hai.
